headline: One call,
every trade sorted.
copy.sub: Plumbing, electrics, plastering and decorating across Tring and nearby. Over 40 years in the trade, and no job too small.
copy.about_alt: A finished lounge with new downlights and a staircase, decorated by Tring Handyman & General Trade
copy.lede: Tracey runs T.P.B, Tring Handyman & General Trade, and has been in the trade for over 40 years. He's a plumber, plasterer, electrician and decorator in one, so a bathroom, a new wall or a list of small jobs gets done by the same person from start to finish. Some customers have used him for around fifteen years, and they say the same thing: reliable, on time, a competitive price and a high standard.
copy.services_intro: Four trades under one roof. Big jobs, small jobs and everything in between.

services.title: Bathroom refits
services.blurb: Old bathrooms stripped out and new ones fitted: suite, shower, boarding, plastering and decorating.
services.intro: One tradesman does the plumbing, walls, electrics and finish, so nobody is waiting on anyone else.

services.title: Plumbing
services.blurb: Leaks, taps, toilets, basins and pipework, fixed or fitted properly.
services.intro: From a dripping tap to new pipework for a whole room.

services.title: Plastering and rendering
services.blurb: Skimming, patching, new walls plastered and outside walls rendered.
services.intro: TPB started out as plasterers, so the walls are the speciality.

services.title: Electrics and PAT testing
services.blurb: Sockets, switches, lights and ceiling fans fitted, plus PAT testing.
services.intro: Small electrical jobs done neatly, alongside the rest of the work.

services.title: Stud walls and alterations
services.blurb: New stud walls, openings and partitions, framed, boarded and plastered.
services.intro: Split a room, close off a space or open one up.
includes: Cables run in as it goes up

services.title: Painting and decorating
services.blurb: Rooms painted top to bottom with clean lines and a tidy finish.
services.intro: The finishing touch on his own work, or a fresh coat on its own.

faqs: Plumbing, electrics, plastering and decorating, plus general jobs like stud walls. One person for the whole job.
Is no job really too small?
No job too small. A dripping tap, one socket or a list of odd jobs is fine.
Can you do a whole bathroom?
Yes. Strip-out, plumbing, boarding, plastering, electrics and decorating, all by the same person.
Yes. Call to arrange a visit.
Do you charge by the hour or by the job?
Small jobs are often charged by the hour or half day. Bigger jobs get a price for the whole thing before work starts.
Tring and the towns around it. Call to check if you're further out.
reviews: I found Tracey to be experienced and deeply knowledgeable across plumbing and electrics. He's responsive, on time, and really personable and wants to genuinely sort a problem properly. I think in today's world where many contractors don't even respond, aren't communicative, late or tricky, people like Tracey are a real rarity! Thank you so much.
I've been using Tracey regularly for probably around fifteen years. He is reliable and always offers a competitive price and works to a high standard. I wholeheartedly recommend him
Have used TPB plasterer for many years. Really reliable and good quality workmanship
